messages.subject: Installing devtools on r 3.1.2
parts:
Hi,


   When I install devtools via RStudio , it thrown dependencies error
   that RCurl and httr are not available. Ironically , I am not to able 
   to install them also.

   Some light on this

   Ubuntu 12.04 and 14.10 

   Even after installing these packages:
  
      libcurl4-gnutls-dev - development files and documentation for libcurl (GnuTLS flavour)
   libcurl4-nss-dev - development files and documentation for libcurl (NSS flavour)
   libcurl4-openssl-dev - development files and documentation for libcurl (OpenSSL flavour)
